question: In what form did the speaker wander within the great liṅga?
premises: The speaker was in the midst of that liṅga
The speaker wandered in the form of Rudra mounted on a bull
inference: Within the liṅga the speaker moved about as Rudra, the bull-mounted one
plain_english: In its midst, I, in the form of Rudra, mounted on the bull, wandered.
